what: the event set for Starcom's Psi Watch board: timed, placed, by kind
use: Exploration and hypotheses. A registered test is scored on events after its seal; these files are history, and each file says where its later events come from.

ucdp_exact.csv.kind: organised violence: an event where armed force killed at least one person (UCDP GED 26.1)
ucdp_exact.csv.time: day (UCDP's local day; date_prec 1, one-day events only), 1989-01-01 to 2025-12-31
ucdp_exact.csv.place: UCDP's coordinates to 4 decimals with where_prec (1 exact place .. 5 first-order region; 6 and 7 country level, placed in no Zone or Sector); ZSP 1.0 Zone and Sector ids where the point lies in one; country as ISO 3166 alpha-2
ucdp_exact.csv.episodes: events of one dyad in one Sector (else one country) within 3 days are one episode; it keeps its first event's id, day and place, `deaths_first_event` is that event's best estimate, and `events` counts the episode's events. Never sum deaths_first_event as a death toll
ucdp_exact.csv.left_out: 1181 events whose side is named for a person; multi-day and imprecisely dated events
ucdp_exact.csv.licence: CC BY 4.0 (UCDP: free to use and redistribute, citing the publications below)
ucdp_exact.csv.credit: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP). Davies, Shawn, Therése Pettersson and Magnus Öberg (2026), Organized violence 1989–2025, and violent political protests, Journal of Peace Research; Sundberg, Ralph and Erik Melander (2013), Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset, Journal of Peace Research 50(4). UCDP is part of and funded by DEMSCORE, national research infrastructure grant 2021-00162 from the Swedish Research Council.
ucdp_exact.csv.later_events: UCDP's candidate events, monthly, about the 20th of the next month

comcat_m55.csv.kind: earthquakes of magnitude 5.5 and up (USGS ComCat), declustered: the 12,160 independent events of 23,258, by the Gardner-Knopoff windows (the aftershocks and foreshocks removed)
comcat_m55.csv.time: to the second (Unix seconds, UTC), 1976-01-01 to 2025-12-31
comcat_m55.csv.place: epicentre to 3 decimals, depth in km; ZSP 1.0 Zone and Sector ids where the epicentre lies in one
comcat_m55.csv.credit: U.S. Geological Survey, ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat)

kp_storm.csv.kind: geomagnetic storm days, Kp 5 or more (G1+), consecutive days joined into one episode
kp_storm.csv.place: the whole Earth (a planetary index): no place
kp_storm.csv.credit: Matzka, J., Stolle, C., Yamazaki, Y., Bronkalla, O. and Morschhauser, A. (2021), The geomagnetic Kp index and derived indices of geomagnetic activity, Space Weather; GFZ Data Services
kp_storm.csv.later_events: GFZ's nowcast and SWPC's Kp, live
